message.content: LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and rose to prominence as a high school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School. Drafted first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in 2003, he has played for the Miami Heat (winning two NBA championships), returned to the Cavaliers (capturing another title in 2016), and currently plays for the Los Angeles Lakers. Known for his versatility—able to play point guard, shooting guard, small forward, power forward, and center—he combines exceptional athleticism, court vision, and scoring ability. Off the court, LeBron is also known for his philanthropy, notably opening the “I Promise” school in Akron, and for his ventures into media, film production, and business.
